subject.title: Markdown table columns misaligned with CJK characters on Telegram and Discord

question: Should maintainers port the linked implementation PR, replace it with a narrow markdown-core PR, or close it before this issue is revisited?
rationale: The issue remains valid, but the open closing PR is conflicting and edits removed renderer paths, so automation should not open another fix lane until maintainers choose how to handle that PR.

options.title: Port The Linked PR
options.body: Move the useful display-width logic and tests from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/55596 into `packages/markdown-core` and keep the old `src/markdown` tree deleted.

options.title: Open A Replacement PR
options.body: If the contributor branch cannot be refreshed safely, create a narrow replacement that credits the existing work and then close the stale PR only after the replacement is viable.

options.title: Close The Candidate PR
options.body: Close the linked PR without replacement only if maintainers decide not to fix this table rendering bug now, leaving this issue open as the canonical report.

recommendation.title: Port The Linked PR
recommendation.body: Move the useful display-width logic and tests from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/55596 into `packages/markdown-core` and keep the old `src/markdown` tree deleted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete committed the original table-conversion behavior and has recent adjacent Markdown rendering context for the owner-boundary decision.
